{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
data = data[data['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Remove refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_by_segment_channel = data.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack()

# Calculate average revenue by segment and channel
revenue_by_segment_channel = data.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['revenue'].mean().unstack()

# Calculate overall conversion rate per channel (unadjusted)
overall_conv_rate_email = data[data['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
overall_conv_rate_paid_search = data[data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Calculate the difference in conversion rate, adjusted for segment
# Use a simple stratified average: weighted average of conversion rates within each segment
segment_counts = data.groupby('customer_segment').size()
total_segment_count = segment_counts.sum()
weights = segment_counts / total_segment_count

# Weighted average conversion rate by channel
weighted_conv_email = (conversion_by_segment_channel['email'] * weights).sum()
weighted_conv_paid_search = (conversion_by_segment_channel['paid_search'] * weights).sum()

# Difference in conversion rate (adjusted)
adjusted_diff = weighted_conv_email - weighted_conv_paid_search

# Compute overall average revenue per channel
avg_revenue_email = data[data['channel'] == 'email']['revenue'].mean()
avg_revenue_paid_search = data[data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue'].mean()

# Output all results
conversion_by_segment_channel, revenue_by_segment_channel, overall_conv_rate_email, overall_conv_rate_paid_search, weighted_conv_email, weighted_conv_paid_search, adjusted_diff, avg_revenue_email, avg_revenue_paid_search"}
